fusions.name: Carving Cut
fusions.desc: A precise cut that deals 30 damage, always strikes critically and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Paring Throw
fusions.desc: Flicks a blade that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet. 20% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Close to Hand
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 12 seconds. You restore 10 health when you use it.

fusions.name: Clean Finish
fusions.desc: Against an enemy below 50% health, your damage rises by 20%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
